stories.title: Brain Execution Lock Model with Heartbeat and Recovery States
stories.description: Define a Brain-specific lock model including lock_id, owner_id, execution_context, acquired_at, ttl_seconds, last_heartbeat_at, and explicit states (active, stale_candidate, expired, recovering) aligned to brain_loop execution semantics and Mongo persistence.

stories.title: Sliding TTL Window with Heartbeat Drift Tolerance
stories.description: Implement TTL evaluation using a sliding window based on last_heartbeat_at with drift tolerance and jitter handling to prevent false expiration during long-running Brain executions.

stories.title: Deadlock Classification and Safe Recovery Strategy
stories.description: Implement classification of lock states (expired, abandoned, conflicting owner) and execute recovery strategies including safe release, backoff, and controlled reacquisition.

stories.title: Internal Lock Management Interface and Brain Runner Integration
stories.description: Expose internal lock operations (acquire, heartbeat, release, force-recover) as callable interfaces and integrate them into brain_runner execution cycles to ensure continuous progress and automated recovery without manual intervention.

stories.title: Crash Recovery and Concurrent Lock Contention Test Suite
stories.description: Create tests simulating process crashes, delayed heartbeats, clock skew, and concurrent lock acquisition contention to validate TTL behavior and deadlock recovery under Brain loop conditions.
